  1. Has a stimulant effect
  2. Causes a dopamine release in the brain
  3. Increases duration of & sensitivity of dompamine reward pathways in the brain
  4. Is inhaled (for faster delivery to the brain; decreasing the time between action & reward, thereby strengthening the association of the reward with the action)
